author: win
html: what do open office applications save their files as.. ? i'm wondering if those files are compatible with existing microsoft office programs ?

author: bact'
html: For its Writer app (MS Word alike)OpenDocument Text (.odt)OpenOffice.org 1.0 Text Document (.sxw)StarWriter 3.0/4.0/5.0 (.sdw)Microsoft Word 6.0/95/97/2000/XP (.doc)Microsoft Word 2003 XML (.xml)HTML Document (.html)Rich Text Format (.rtf)Text (.txt)i.e. MS Word compatible (can import/export .doc)other OO.o apps also compatible with MS Office apps as well.Anyway, do not expect 100% compat.Since what OOo do is kinda reverse-engineering ..but don't worry — no major data loss, most of the time is just a cosmetic issue(font size changed, a picture is slightly shifted left from itsoriginal place ..etc)
